title: What’s Sizzling and What’s Stable? Inside the AI Native Tool Landscape with Patrick & Amir
description:
Six months after our first AI Native DevCon, the landscape of AI-driven tools has continued to evolve. Our recently launched AI-Native tooling landscape now tracks more than 280 innovative solutions, revealing clear shifts and powerful new dynamics in software development. AI-powered agents—previously an experimental frontier—have rapidly matured into dependable, everyday tools that automate core aspects of the software lifecycle, from gathering requirements to code auditing.

Simultaneously, new groundbreaking practices, like vibecoding, are injecting creativity and collaboration into developer workflows, turning AI into not merely an assistant, but a true partner in the process.

This session takes you on a lively tour about these shifts, clearly distinguishing between tools that have become foundational and those pushing the boundaries into exciting, uncharted territory.

Join Patrick and Amir to stay ahead, understand what's ready today, and what will sizzle tomorrow.
